scenes.title: App Toolkit
scenes.action: The existing toolbox mark arrives among the product's Material shapes.

scenes.title: Open the toolbox
scenes.action: The real lid and handle hinge back, exposing the box.

scenes.title: Many tools.
scenes.action: Six real Quick Tools widgets spring out with fully rounded corners.

scenes.title: One place.
scenes.action: The box leaves; the widgets settle into the measured app bento geometry.

scenes.title: Quick tools.
scenes.action: The camera pulls back; the official Pixel skin and real shell form around the same tiles. The compass turns and the level settles.

scenes.title: Measure.
scenes.action: The Measure tab opens from its real navigation target. The counter advances beside the live screen.

scenes.title: Let chance decide.
scenes.action: Play & Decide opens; the real wheel spins to Sushi, with random number, coin and dice visible on the screen.

scenes.title: App Toolkit. Your toolkit.
scenes.action: Three real destinations fan out beside the mark and the original Google Play badge. Music finishes naturally.
